party_a.description: Party A — the first contracting party. Loan contract (VN): the lender (bank / credit institution). Account-opening form (VN): the bank. EN synthetic contract: the first named party.
party_a.format: keep the full legal name exactly as written

party_b.description: Party B — the second contracting party. Loan contract (VN): the borrower. Account-opening form (VN): the account holder (customer). EN synthetic contract: the second named party.
party_b.format: keep the full legal name exactly as written

effective_date.description: Signing date or effective date of the contract. Return null if not present on the visible page.
effective_date.format: keep the original format as written in the document; null if absent

term.description: Contract term or duration (e.g. loan period, end date of agreement). Return null if not applicable or not present (e.g. account-opening forms typically have no fixed term).
term.format: keep the original format as written; null if absent or not applicable

governing_law.description: Governing law or jurisdiction clause. VN contracts: usually 'Pháp luật nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt Nam'. Return null if not visible on the document.
governing_law.format: keep verbatim as written; null if absent

contract_number.description: Contract number or ID (số hợp đồng). For VN bank loan contracts: printed reference number. For account-opening forms: the form sequence number. Return null if not present.
contract_number.format: keep the identifier exactly as printed, including any prefix and separators; null if absent

contract_value.description: Contract value or loan amount (giá trị hợp đồng / số tiền vay). Loan contract: the disbursed loan amount. Account-opening form: not applicable — return null.
contract_value.format: keep the original currency symbol and number format if present; null if absent or not applicable
